related_resources.reason: Over 1,300 beads from Vat Komnou and composition of comparative Óc Eo samples show South Asian material connections and inland regional alliance networks; full article not inspected.
Angkor Borei excavations suggest occupation from the fourth century BCE and a connected delta settlement system; research questions remain active.
Vietnamese nomination compiles excavations showing stilt housing, craft workshops, glass beads and changing delta waterfront; interpretations reflect a nomination dossier.
OSL canal-bed estimates broadly span first millennium BCE through mid-first millennium CE; fourth–fifth-century infill samples suggest changes, not certain depopulation.
